purpose: deploy-time substitute for the full ladder-conformance rung on an inert-path change (maintainer decision 2026-08-04, recorded in the design doc amendment): the ladder's breadth serves quality measurement; an inertness claim is better served by exact within-question pairing of old vs new code on identical inputs — the reproducible server makes any difference attributable to code alone.
